name: Grande Ronde River (Troy – Boggan's)
gaugeName: Grande Ronde River at Troy, OR
blurb: Remote basalt canyon in Washington's southeast corner below Troy, Oregon.

sections.notes: Long day. Take out at the public WDFW Boggans water-access site (unimproved ramp) at the SR 129 bridge; Boggan's Oasis next door is a private store that runs shuttles. The put-in is in Oregon, so Oregon boating rules apply until the river enters Washington. Oregon Waterway Access Permit required for non-motorized boats on the Oregon part of the river; since Jan 1, 2026 it applies to boats of any length ($6/7 days, $20/yr). WDFW Boggans take-out: Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
